user.title: Connect your KilnAid account
user.description:
Kiln Monitor connects to the Bartlett KilnAid cloud service to track your kiln's temperature, status, and firing history. Sign in with the same email and password you use in the KilnAid mobile app.

If you don't have an account yet, create one in the KilnAid app first, pair it with your kiln, and then return here.

data_description.email: The email address you use to sign in to the KilnAid mobile app.
data_description.password: The password for your KilnAid account. It is stored locally in Home Assistant and only sent to Bartlett's login service.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate KilnAid account
reauth_confirm.description:
Home Assistant can no longer sign in to KilnAid as **{email}**. This usually means the password was changed in the KilnAid app, or the stored session has expired.

Enter the current password to reconnect. No sensors will be removed and your history will be preserved.

data_description.password: The password that currently works in the KilnAid mobile app for {email}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the KilnAid service. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: That email and password combination was rejected by KilnAid. Try signing in with the KilnAid app to confirm your credentials.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This KilnAid account is already set up in Home Assistant.

init.title: Kiln Monitor settings
init.description:
Kiln Monitor uses adaptive polling: it checks the KilnAid cloud service frequently when a kiln is **actively firing**, and less often when it's idle. This keeps temperature updates responsive during a firing without hammering Bartlett's servers the rest of the time.

The kiln is treated as "active" whenever its status reports **Firing**. Any other status (idle, ready, cooling, off, etc.) uses the idle interval.

Set both intervals below. Setting them to the same value disables adaptive polling and always polls at that rate.

data_description.active_update_interval: How often to poll while a kiln is firing. Allowed range: 5–60 minutes. Recommended: 5 minutes.
data_description.idle_update_interval: How often to poll while no kiln is firing. Allowed range: 5–120 minutes. Recommended: 15 minutes.
